production_equation_authority.publication: G. Lugones and J. E. Horvath, Color-flavor locked strange matter, Physical Review D 66, 074017 (2002)
production_equation_authority.role: full finite-strange-mass common-Fermi-momentum thermodynamic potential and separately identified lowest-order approximation
production_equation_authority.implemented_branch: full finite-ms free integrals plus leading minus_3_Delta_squared_mu_squared_over_pi_squared condensation term and bag term

frozen_parameter_support.publication: G. Lugones and J. E. Horvath, High-density QCD pairing in compact star structure, Astronomy and Astrophysics 403, 173-178 (2003)

reported_parameter_family.reported_high_mass_scope: small_B_high_Delta pure bare self_bound CFL sequences approaching 2.4 solar masses

frozen_parameter_support.convention_warning: B=57.5 MeV fm^-3 is the authoritative input; it is not B^(1/4)=57.5 MeV. Its derived fourth root is 144.97957215191494 MeV.

pure_self_bound_star_benchmark_authority.publication: G. Lugones and J. E. Horvath, High-density QCD pairing in compact star structure, Astronomy and Astrophysics 403, 173-178 (2003)
pure_self_bound_star_benchmark_authority.scope: pure self-bound CFL strange-star sequences and sensitivity to B, m_s, and Delta
pure_self_bound_star_benchmark_authority.parameter_convention_note: the article varies B directly in MeV fm^-3, includes m_s=100 MeV and Delta=100 MeV in the plotted parameter families, and identifies small B with high Delta as the high-mass direction

strange_matter_and_two_flavor_window.publication: E. Farhi and R. L. Jaffe, Strange matter, Physical Review D 30, 2379 (1984)
strange_matter_and_two_flavor_window.project_use: absolute three-flavor stability and separate ordinary-nuclei/two-flavor safety logic

CFL_pairing_stress.publication: M. Alford, C. Kouvaris, and K. Rajagopal, Gapless color-flavor-locked quark matter, Physical Review Letters 92, 222001 (2004)

neutrality_authority.publication: M. Alford, K. Rajagopal, S. Reddy, and F. Wilczek, The minimal CFL-nuclear interface, Physical Review D 64, 074017 (2001)
neutrality_authority.project_use: locally neutral ideal CFL bulk has mu_e=0 and no electron pressure contribution

binary64_identity_policy.authority: formula-derived values from the frozen constants, never rounded endpoint replacement
binary64_identity_policy.surface_pressure_policy: subtract the one globally constant binary64 residual at approved mu_surface so P_surface is exactly zero and all derivatives are unchanged

numerical_reconstruction_policy.reason: avoid cancellation in narrow-ramp Gaussian moments while preserving the exact surface and A=0 identity
numerical_reconstruction_policy.verification: multi-scale independent quadrature and finite-difference derivative tests

stellar_sequence_policy.scope: explicitly declared bare CFL surface only; no inherited hadronic minimum mass or minimum radius cuts
stellar_sequence_policy.source_locations: Postnikov-Prakash-Lattimer 2010, Eqs. 8-11 and Sections IV and VI.B
stellar_sequence_policy.derivation: P_c/epsilon_surface tending to zero gives epsilon approximately epsilon_surface, M approximately G_CONV*epsilon_surface*R^3/3 and k2 tending to 3/4; no hadronic minimum mass or radius follows
stellar_sequence_policy.retained_checks: positive finite mass and radius, valid domain, successful surface event, compactness bound, and exact tidal status; existing hadronic policy unchanged

stellar_local_refinement_policy.definition: subdivide each side of the sampled three-point turning bracket in log pressure, retaining all three original pressure nodes exactly
stellar_local_refinement_policy.reason: avoid a second floating-point representation of the original midpoint creating a spurious mass secant
stellar_local_refinement_policy.retained_checks: one positive-to-negative turning point, bounded background refinement, original tolerances and fail-closed sign checks; legacy BSk24 grid unchanged
stellar_local_refinement_policy.verification: analytic log-pressure parabola, exact seed-reuse regression, and independent enthalpy stellar solver

external_assumptions.ordinary_nuclei_two_flavor_safety: not demonstrable from a CFL-only phase; requires an independently defined two-flavor model with energy per baryon at zero pressure at least 934 MeV. The selected B=57.5 MeV fm^-3 lies at the approximate lower stability edge quoted in the source and must not be described as an independently checked two-flavor pass.
external_assumptions.renormalization_scale: not applicable because no perturbative correction is included

source_storage_policy.reason: The package records direct primary-source links and frozen conventions; external papers are not vendored.
